title: CatalogLayer
description: One permitted layer in the authorized catalog returned by GET /catalog. Layers describe spatial publication transports (NeoServer OGC endpoints via the same-origin gateway) plus domain transports, with an explicit property projection: only fields listed in propertyProjection may appear in features, tiles and exports for that layer. A layer is delivered only when allow_public_read or allow_protected holds for the caller.

id.description: Stable layer identifier used as the GeoLibre layer id.

layerType.description: Transport family. MVT paths are z/y/x; WMS overlays prefer EPSG:3857; see the technical specification's transport table.

sourceUrl.description: Same-origin gateway route (allowlisted path), never a raw upstream NeoServer URL.

visibility.description: Publication class. Cohort layers require every member to be entitled to all published fields.

propertyProjection.description: Closed allowlist of fields exposed by this layer. Gate codes, internal notes, contacts and credentials can never appear here.

dataRevision.description: Publication revision token; changes when the backing publication view is refreshed.

styles.description: Layer style hints (opacity, symbols, color ramps) keyed by style id.
